tools.name: http_get
tools.description: Fetches a page of Roblox's documentation as text: the Engine API reference (https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/<Class>.md, also datatypes/, enums/, globals/, libraries/), creator guides (https://create.roblox.com/docs/<path>.md), the Cloud API (https://create.roblox.com/docs/cloud/...), performance guides, and the llms.txt indexes (https://create.roblox.com/docs/llms.txt, .../reference/engine/llms.txt, .../cloud/llms.txt). Roblox's creator-docs repository on GitHub is allowed too; nothing else is. With query, only the lines holding it (ignoring case) are returned, with context_lines around each, or one line saying nothing matched.

url.description: The page to fetch, such as https://create.roblox.com/docs/reference/engine/classes/TweenService.md.

query.description: A keyword to search the page for. Only matching lines and their context are returned.

context_lines.description: Lines kept on each side of a match. Defaults to 3.

return_full.description: With query: return the whole page when the query matches, instead of excerpts.

studio_id.description: The editor to act on, from list_roblox_studios. May be left out when only one editor is open.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Returns detailed guidance and best practices for one kind of Roblox work, to read before doing it. Called without a name, lists every skill with a one-line description. Skills cover Luau scripting, UI design that fits the game, UX, accessibility, animation and tweening, client/server security, data persistence, monetization, analytics and live configs, Server Authority, input across devices, performance, debugging, testing and searching the documentation with http_get.

# Skill: docs-search

# Searching the Roblox documentation

Roblox APIs change: members get deprecated, new classes appear, limits move.
Before you write code against an API you are not certain about, read its page
with `http_get`. A wrong method name costs the user a debugging session; a
lookup costs one call.

`create.roblox.com/docs` serves every page as Markdown when `.md` is added to
its URL, and lists its pages in `llms.txt` indexes.
